sources.title: GitHub - open-jarvis/OpenJarvis: Personal AI, On Personal Devices
sources.snippet: OpenJarvis is that stack. It is a framework for local-first personal AI, built around three core ideas: shared primitives for building on-device agents; evaluations that treat energy, FLOPs, latency, and dollar cost as first-class constraints alongside accuracy; and a learning loop that improves models using local trace data.

sources.title: GitHub - jaiprakash323/ai-research-assistant: AI-Python
sources.snippet: AI Research & Knowledge Assistant A production-oriented backend for uploading, searching, and reasoning over large collections of PDF documents using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), hybrid search, TensorFlow-based document classification, multi-document comparison/summarization, and conversational memory.
